interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, paved, ADA-compliant sidewalk to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Utilize the existing median space to create a raised refuge island, reducing the unprotected crossing distance.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalk and Signalization
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk and a pedestrian-activated signal (such as a HAWK signal) to facilitate safe crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair the cracked and uneven pavement in the pedestrian walkway to ensure a smooth, accessible surface.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to provide a leading pedestrian interval, allowing pedestrians to enter the crosswalk before vehicles get a green light.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.

interventions.title: Raised Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous, raised concrete sidewalk with a vertical curb to provide physical separation between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Mark the roadway with high-visibility continental crosswalks at the nearest intersection to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing and Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes or the number of lanes to slow traffic and shorten the pedestrian crossing distance.

interventions.title: Street Tree Infill
interventions.description: Plant additional street trees in the buffer zone to provide vertical friction, which naturally slows traffic, and improves the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals at the distant intersection to provide safe crossing opportunities.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Utilize the existing median space to create protected refuge islands for pedestrians crossing the wide roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install continuous, ADA-compliant paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Continuity
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk through the paved lot area with clear markings or a raised path to maintain a dedicated pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers, enhancing safety after dark.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island in the existing median to facilitate safe crossing.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing / Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes or the number of lanes to lower vehicle speeds and reduce the total crossing distance.

interventions.title: Enhanced Street Tree Canopy
interventions.description: Plant additional street trees in the grass buffer to provide vertical enclosure, which naturally slows traffic and improves the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Install Sidewalks
interventions.description: Construct continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide safe separation for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Pedestrian Crossings
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and pedestrian signals at appropriate intervals to facilitate safe crossing of the multi-lane road.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes or narrow existing lanes to slow traffic and provide space for bicycle infrastructure.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and personal security after dark.

interventions.title: Street Tree Planting
interventions.description: Plant street trees in the buffer zone to provide shade, improve the aesthetic environment, and create a vertical sense of enclosure that naturally slows traffic.

interventions.title: Curb and Gutter Installation
interventions.description: Install a concrete curb to clearly define the roadway edge and provide better physical separation between vehicles and the pedestrian zone.

interventions.title: Speed Management
interventions.description: Implement traffic calming measures or reduce the posted speed limit to lower vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Install Continuous Sidewalks
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on both sides of the road to provide physical separation for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Improvements
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks, pedestrian refuge islands in the median, and signalized crossings.

interventions.title: Road Diet or Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Narrow travel lanes or reduce the number of lanes to lower vehicle speeds and shorten crossing distances.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Installing a marked crossing with a pedestrian refuge island to facilitate safe movement across the arterial.

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: If pedestrian demand warrants, install a marked crossing with appropriate signage to provide a safe point for crossing the roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-Block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and signage to provide a legal and safer crossing point for residents.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB)
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-activated warning lights to alert drivers to the presence of people crossing the multi-lane road.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalk and Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and pedestrian warning signs to alert drivers to the presence of people crossing.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to naturally slow vehicle speeds and shorten the crossing distance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Implement a marked crossing with high-visibility paint and signage to alert drivers to pedestrian presence.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island and Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked midblock crossing with a raised refuge island in the median to break up the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Plant trees along the roadside to provide a buffer and create visual friction to naturally slow vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add street lighting along the sidewalk to improve visibility, security, and comfort for pedestrians at night.
